stance_basis: agency commends cooperative agreement for Keowee-Jocassee lands but questions whether it compensates for wildlife productivity loss from Bad Creek Project
summary: The South Carolina Wildlife and Marine Resources Department is referenced throughout the document primarily as a data source for wildlife, fishery, and water quality information related to the project area. In its formal comment role, the agency commended the applicant's cooperative wildlife management agreement for Keowee-Jocassee Project lands while questioning whether such measures adequately compensate for the loss of wildlife productivity associated with the proposed Bad Creek Project. The agency also contributed fishery survey data, creel census data, and trout habitat assessments used extensively in the EIS.
